comparison: All complete published CXR arms, plus joint-Q partial cohorts separately labeled; no oracle per-question combination.
archive_source: Frozen published request/reply evidence, never the changed live private SLAKE directory.
terminal: Last actual request only; explicit fixed whole-arm reuse chain if no new request. Unknown sent, unhealthy tool stop, graph limit and native tool plan are not completed answers.
adapter_status: Project integration adapter, not a universal official parser or a new learned answer judge.
answer_extraction: An explicit string answer in the whole JSON, including full JSON fence, regardless of reason/extra keys/length.
Explicit answer strings in complete outer JSON objects embedded in prose; never descend into reason or a malformed outer object.
Joint-Q answer objects keyed by the actual question_id, not reference.
Multiple distinct explicit answers remain ambiguous; no choosing based on correctness, reason or order.
Explicit labeled answer line, otherwise entire natural-language reply retained without semantic guessing.
mcq_metric: Unique explicit supplied letter, full exact option text, or internally consistent labeled option maps to choice; compare choice with reference. This is a common explicit-answer adapter plus choice accuracy, not untouched author raw-parser reproduction.
text_metrics: M4CXR answer-string EM after exact author special-token/period/case cleaning and reference-word-set recall. On VQA-RAD116 this is an explicitly declared application of the published metric, not a MedRAX paper VQA-RAD result.
json_compliance: Separate original exactM answer/reason two-string/300-character statistic, not a correctness prerequisite in aligned metric.

legacy_sensitivity.source: CheXagent BaseLM parenthesized letter extraction, applied only to extracted explicit answer text (never reason).
legacy_sensitivity.row_order: canonical input order within each arm, RNG reset per arm
legacy_sensitivity.fallback: Report no-match count and separate seeded random-fallback credit; no extracted answer/technical stop remains a real missing outcome.
legacy_sensitivity.limitation: Not exact paper reproduction: source prompts/output interfaces and paper seeds are not identical; random credit is not model evidence.

source_uncertainty: CXRAgent exact benchmark parser unknown; SLAKE matching114 does not prove identical paper question IDs.
analysis_gate: Review adapter/protocol and reference-free complete archive inventory before generating aligned target score tables. No new target model generation.
